name: create_photo_social_graphic
description: Design a social graphic that uses photos (hero image, overlays, stock or supplied assets) with typography. Produces a PNG via HTML/CSS and/or raster compositing.

content.description: Exact text and facts to show. Do not invent copy.

designBrief.description: Visual direction: mood, colors, layout (full-bleed photo, split layout, etc.).

platform.description: Target preset: instagram_post, instagram_story, twitter_post, linkedin_post, facebook_cover, youtube_thumbnail, open_graph. Default instagram_post.

imagePaths.description: Workspace-relative paths to images already in the session (logos, photos).

imageUrls.description: HTTPS URLs to download into workspace before layout.

stockQuery.description: Optional Unsplash search query when no imagePaths/imageUrls are provided.
